As designers get nostalgic for the flamboyant ’80s, sequins go gangsta and shiny vinyl finds its way back into our closet. This season sparkle comes imbued with a street sensibility as the more-is-more mantra from our favourite decade clashes with athleisure’s fluid dynamism. Cue the season’s sharpest plissé skirts teamed with a pair of equally luxe sneakers. Designers drummed up a host of options that make an easy transition from the cubicle to the dance floor. We’re looking to Michael Kors’ slashed sequinned mini dresses and Phoebe Philo’s egg-shaped lurex pullovers at Céline for inspiration. “I like bare legs in winter; I like night for day. I like Alexa Chung mixing with Nan Kempner. It’s about the interesting mix,” said Kors in an interview post his show. At Kenzo, Humberto Leon and Carol Lim sent out a line of vinyl dresses and skirts, foil-print trousers and oversized metallic jackets. Isabel Marant flirted with vinyl too in retro styles, adding animal prints and plaid to the mix. “It really goes back to when I would sneak out, aged 15, to punk clubs like Le Palace and Les Bains Douches,” said the Parisian designer. Between Marc Jacobs’ subversive separates at NYFW and Rajesh Pratap Singh’s gilded army closer home, the message is loud and clear—street glamour is here to stay. Designer Sanchita Ajjampur’s futuristic mash of foil, mesh and paillettes, and Gaurav Jai Gupta’s street-style spin on metallic handlooms, further confirm the mood of the times. It’s evident that fashion is making no bones about its Ziggy Stardust-meets-Beyoncé philosophy, and the pop culture influencers are lapping it up. Historically, the first image that comes to mind in this category is that of  ’60s fashion icon and rocker Keith Richards’s then girlfriend Anita Pallenberg who took to the Cannes red carpet in a lurex jumper. Leave it to the Kardashian-Jenner clan to reinvent Pallenberg’s louche luxe uniform as they elevate street style basics like sweatshirts, lace-up boots and trackpants. Kendall Jenner even brought back the chainmail dress from the ’90s. Closer home Alia Bhatt is having a go with unexpected pairings like a camo shirt and a plissé skirt, offering us a fresh take on the trend.      Which brings us to the question of how to do it right. Archana Walavalkar, celebrity stylist and co-founder Stylecracker, says that styling is everything here. “It’s important to blend the look seamlessly, not letting the shiny piece acquire hero status at any point.” It’s a good idea to stock up on basics like hologram sweatshirts, sequinned numbered tees, slip dresses with a glamorous sheen, and metallic denims. If you’re shine-shy, begin with a statement accessory. Let the gleaming heels from Demna Gvasalia’s debut at Balenciaga or Fendi’s festive-edition gold totes give you some ideas. “Go casual with jeans and a tee teamed with embellished sandals. This is easier to pull off if you don’t quite dare to go all guns blazing,” says Ajjampur. Fine jewellery is also following suit by putting a casual spin to sparkle. Case in point: Nirav Modi’s Embrace range of diamond bangles, which stretch like a dream, offer a snug fit and are best worn with denims and a boyfriend shirt. The writing’s on the wall: Whatever your glittery vice may be, it’s time to wear it on your sleeve.   Wendell Rodricks is a man credited with many firsts. At a time when Indian fashion was all about opulence and grandeur, he introduced the idea of minimalism. He was one of the few Indian designers to bring eco-friendly textiles to the forefront and also pioneered resortwear in India. To commemorate his contributions to the fashion industry, Rodricks was awarded the Padma Shri title in 2014. While contemporaries are predictably passing on their legacies and labels to family members, the designer has entrusted it into the hands of young prodigy Schulen Fernandes. And he did it in his inimitable style, bang in the middle of the runway at his label's fall/winter showing at the 2016 Lakmé Fashion Week (LFW). In a fun, free-wheeling chat, Rodricks and Fernandes tell us about what's in store for the legendary label.Wendell, after holding the reins for 28 years, you've decided to hand them over to Schulen. Schulen, how did he break it to you and what was your reaction?Wendell Rodricks: I always wanted the label to go to somebody I trusted. Schulen came to me straight from college and she has been with me for four years. She had already started taking a lot of creative decisions for the label. For instance, last season we did the Indica Emporia presentation at LFW with vintage Indian garments. It was completely her vision and work from start to end. I wanted to slowly take the backseat with this label so that I could make time for my other passions. I felt the time was just right for her to take the label and fly with it.Schulen Fernandes: It obviously didn't happen out of the blue. The handover was always on the cards and it took two years of work laying the foundation. However, when the actual moment arrived, it was hard to believe. How are your roles divided in the new scheme of things?WR: I’d like to think of myself as a benevolent dictator (laughs). On a serious note, Schulen has complete freedom to realise her creative vision at the label now and I am happy to have her take over.SF: Wendell will obviously be the mentor. My work will now involve everything from conceptualising collections to actually bringing it to life. I am also excited about the business end of it and we have a competent team to help us on that front.Schulen, tell us a little bit about your debut collection, Trapezoid, for the Wendell Rodricks label presented at LFW. And, Wendell, what did you think of it?SF: I have always loved architecture and geometry. The trapezoid form has been used in architecture from ancient times and it is so versatile. We decided to explore it in fashion with this collection. We used a mix of structured shapes and fluid fabrics working with paper silks, chanderis and a lot of eco-friendly materials. WR: I was really surprised when Schulen came up with the idea. It is a form that I've seen in Inca and Aztec architecture and in our temple gopurams. The Indian woman's body which is narrow at the shoulders and wide at the hips also follows the trapezoid form. This was particularly relevant because for the first time we introduced a size chart specific to the Indian woman at LFW this season. I felt really proud watching the show. The biggest compliment to me and to Schulen was when people told us it (the collection) looked like Wendell Rodricks. When a new creative leader takes charge at a fashion house, change is afoot—what can we expect from the label?WR: I've always focussed on high-end fashion and have never been able to cater to the mid-range. I hope Schulen will be able to expand the reach of this label to more people the way my colleague Anita Dongre has done very successfully. I also want her to take risks with the label and be more experimental.SF: We will definitely retain the minimalistic language and eco-friendly DNA of the label as we move forward. I would like to introduce newer, younger silhouettes and experiment heavily with materials. What lies ahead for both of you? Wendell, do you miss being behind the wheel? Schulen, are you at all daunted?WR: I don’t miss being behind the wheel at all. I can finally dedicate time to things that I’ve been waiting to do. The work on the museum is underway (Rodricks is turning his Goa home into a space dedicated to Goan costumes). The dogs are taking it well but my three cats are giving me grief about the move! I would like to write a lot more. My next book Poskem is about Goa. I hope I’ll be able to turn it into a movie like Chetan Bhagat (laughs). I’d like to teach a lot more too.SF: I am excited about what lies ahead and loving every minute of my new job. Airport style has recently gained momentum, thanks to the growing paparazzi culture. Every celebrity has a distinctive travel style, but there’s a common love shared for the closet staple kurta. Instead of flexing their sartorial muscles in high-end, street-style brands, the leading ladies have chosen the simple kurta as their favourite. Of course, they amp it up with their Hermès Birkin and Gucci sunglasses, but the dainty kurta sets still takes the centre stage. While Deepika Padukone prefers her kurtas to be form-fitted in bright, jewel tones, Kareena Kapoor is a fan of over-sized kurtas in neutral shades. Colour blocking is a versatile trend that is no longer restricted to just mixing two colours in an outfit. You can colour-block your look by teaming separates in two different hues or by teaming a singular-toned outfit with a contrasting coloured accessory or shoes. Bring out some bold hues and style them together like Alia Bhatt did; or break the monotony of solid black outfit with a dash of colour like Kareena Kapoor Khan. For those who aren’t a fan of busy prints and multiple elements, this trend is a perfect pick. Here’s our edit of all the celebrity-approved ways to flaunt the colour-block trend in style  Kareena Kapoor KhanEver thought two bright tones cannot work together? Take a cue from Kareena Kapoor Khan. The actor styled her aqua-blue bodysuit with a neon green, sequined, pencil skirt. Neutralising the look further with a pair of transparent, strappy heel.  Kriti SanonKriti Sanon effortlessly worked this form-fitting colour-blocked gown. She kept the rest of her look minimal with a pair of dainty, hoop earrings, and centre-parted hair.  Aditi Rao Hydari Aditi Rao Hydari demonstrated a distinctive of wearing the power suit. She opted for an ox-blood and burnt orange asymmetrical pantsuit, which she styled with a traditional choker.  Tara SutariTara Sutaria broke the monotony of her black and white outfit by teaming it with a bright neon skirt, another way of working the colour-block trend.  Athiya ShettyAthiya Shetty opted for a contrasting gown in lime green and beige, working two contradicting hues in the same outfit.  Alia BhattInstead of infusing multiple colours in the same outfit, Alia Bhatt chose contrasting separates in two bright hues, an innovative way of sporting the colour-block trend.					The sporty-chic dress trend is a cheat sheet for those who like to appear stylish without compromising on functionality. Sporty dresses don’t necessarily have to be made from active-wear material, all it needs to be is comfortable with an athletic feel to it. Sartorial expert Sonam Kapoor Ahuja wore a mustard yellow, pocketed dress, with stripe detail, teamed with a pair of funky dad-sneakers, adding to the sporty vibe. On the other hand, Ananya Panday demonstrated a different way of wearing the trend by opting for a crayon blue, wrap dress by Balenciaga and teamed it with a pair of strappy heels. Here’s our edit of all the different ways in which you can sport the trend.  Kriti SanonKriti Sanon styled her geometrically-patterned, hoodie-dress with a pair of white sneakers, showing you how to upgrade your travel style.  Kareena Kapoor Khan Kareena Kapoor Khan wore a beige and bottle green coloured, pocketed dress with centre zip detail. Giving the sporty dress trend an unusual spin.  Sonakshi SinhaSonakshi Sinha layered her royal blue, dual-slit, fitted dress with an oversized, monochrome, printed jacket, elevating the glamour quotient of the look. Vaani KapoorVaani Kapoor styled her neon short dress with a monotoned jacket, demonstrating a different way of working the sporty dress trend.  Sonam Kapoor AhujaThe actor gave her regular look a sporty upgrade by teaming her midnight blue, pleated dress with a bright red sweater from Bhaane’s latest collection. Sonam further dialled it up a notch by wearing statement silver jewellery with an athletic look. The geometrical shape can be carved out from the centre, showing your toned midriff or from the sides and the back, accentuating your curves. Recently, Kareena Kapoor Khan was seen in a lemon yellow, diamond-shaped, midriff cut-out dress by Dion Lee, at the trailer launch of her movie. The actor teamed the dress with a pair of strappy heels, dainty earrings and hexagon-shaped glasses. You can easily replicate this look at your next Sunday brunch with the girls. The young actor complemented the ensemble with a pair of statement Sophie Webster heels and a stark red mouth. The big, puffy tulle gowns, with a Carrie Bradshaw stamp of approval, are having a major moment in fashion right now. With the recent resurgence of maximalism, celebrities are pulling all the stops with these candy-floss resembling couture gowns.Deepika Padukone has championed the art of wearing the voluminous gowns and has demonstrated different ways to work it on the red carpet. She recently wore a ballet-pink and black, off-shouldered tulle gown by Giambattista Valli at the closing ceremony of a film festival. The actor kept the rest of her look minimal with dainty jewellery and dewy makeup. Contradicting her classic-chic look, was Malaika Arora, who stepped out looking like a fiery goddess in an asymmetrical, scarlet gown by the same designer. She elevated her look with layered pearl necklaces, shimmering eyelids and a stark red mouth. Here’s a round-up of all the different ways in which celebrities have demonstrated this trend. Deepika PadukoneDeepika Padukone’s love affair with fluffy, capacious gowns goes way back. The actor decoded this tried-and-tested formula on the Cannes runway two years ago and has showcased multiple ways of wearing the large couture ensembles ever since. Priyanka Chopra JonasPriyanka Chopra Jonas made her Cannes red carpet debut this year. For one of her appearances with her husband Nick Jonas, she opted for a pristine white, multi-layered, Georges Hobeika gown. Chopra Jonas punctuated her look with a dainty diamond necklace, pulled back sleek hair and her signature warm-toned makeup. Sonam Kapoor AhujaWhen it comes to defying the fashion norms, nobody does it quite like Sonam Kapoor Ahuja. The sartorial expert gave the big tulle gown trend her own spin in this raven black, pre-stitched, gown-sari by Shehlaa Khan, detailed with exaggerated sleeves. She dialled it up a notch by teaming it up with a veiled fascinator by Philip Treacy. Aishwarya Rai BachchanAishwarya Rai Bachchan took the red-carpet game to a whole another level with this extravagant, feather detailed, Ashi-studio tulle gown. The actor who is a regular at Cannes Film festival has upscaled the bar for her contemporaries. Sara Ali KhanShe may be new to the world of Bollywood but isn’t a rookie when it comes to fashion. Sara Ali Khan looked like a vision in this 3D dimensional, tulle gown by Gaurav Gupta for a recently held award function.					There are risqué trends, and then there is the cut-out dress trend. Besides impressing the long list of relatives and your secret office crush with your sartorial choices, you also need to get some Instagram-worthy shots for the grid. To make all your festive looks distinctive from one another, you need to strategically plan your wardrobe for all the different occasions you've sent an RSVP to.While you can wear a long and flowing Anarkali for a puja, you can dial it up a notch by opting for an elegant sari to the late-night card party. Planning your festive wardrobe can get exhausting and monotonous. While playing dress-up is fun, the idea of wearing heavy-duty lehengas and saris to each event can get taxing. Long nights of card parties, endless Diwali lunches and that office party you can’t miss – there’s a smart way of showing up to all these occasions without making it look repetitive. Ditch your traditional blouse for a crisp white shirt and pair it with a bright-coloured lehenga and a pair of statement earrings, a classic Karisma Kapoor move. Swap the voluminous skirt for a flared pair of palazzos, and team it with a cropped top, just like Sara Ali Khan did. Here’s our edit of all the unconventional ways in which you can spruce up your festive style. Alia BhattWho needs a blouse when you can perfectly work the printed Sabyasachi sari like Alia Bhatt. Add a pair of shoulder dusters and you’re good to go. Taapsee PannuDenim sari? Yes, please. Taapsee Pannu doesn’t abide by your conventional rule book, seen here in a denim sari paired with a collared blouse. A breezy look for all the fashion rebels.A hybrid silhouette between a sari and a pantsuit. Tapsee Pannu opted for this all-white ensemble by starch the label and made a strong case for androgynous dressing with a twist. Karisma KapoorKarisma Kapoor wore a straight-fit kurta, layered with a jacket both by Antar-Agni, and punctuated the look with a pair of white kicks. This one is for all the girls who live in their denim and sneakers, wanting to stick to the same formula even during the festive season. Sonakshi SinhaIf you’ve got abs, it's morally incorrect to keep them hidden. Sonakshi Sinha working her cool-girl spell as per usual in these culottes cropped top and patchwork jacket set by Anamika Khanna. Shilpa Shetty KundraShilpa Shetty Kundra flaunting her statuesque figure in this metallic sari-gown by Amit Aggarwal. If you’re looking for a form-flattering, modern silhouette, this is it. Sonam Kapoor AhujaAlways ahead of the curve, Sonam Kapoor Ahuja looked splendid in an off-white, plunging kurta and pant set, teamed with a blazer and a gold choker. Calling out all the risk-taker who can efficiently strut in in this décolletage neckline bearing ensemble. Sara Ali KhanThe next-gen Bollywood actress looked like a vision in a navy-blue copped top and flared palazzo set by Nupur Kanoi. If you’re looking for a blend of Indian and western sensibilities, this ensemble is perfect for you. Janhvi KapoorThe young and effervescent Janhvi Kapoor opted for a ruffled, cropped white shirt over her shimmering, powder blue lehenga by Abu Jani-Sandeep Khosla. An innovative trick to offset the look by keeping the bottom half heavy and upper half light.					Planning your festive wardrobe can get exhausting and monotonous. Yes, we love Diwali and everything that comes with it. But wait. How exactly do you embrace the festive spirit at your workplace without going overboard? We are here to help you with your dilemma. Here is a list of some fun outfits that you can flaunt at your workplace without hassle. Pair with palazzos Palazzos are effortlessly stylish and comfortable. They are an undeniable fashion must-have. Pair them up with a stylish silk or georgette blouse with traditional prints. Add a chunky beaded ethnic necklace to complete your look. How about a long, elegant kurti to go along with a pair of flared palazzos? We love this look because it is sophisticated and oh-so-stunning. Go ahead and throw on some bangles to amp up the ethnic quotient. Now that we're talking about comfort, what are your thoughts on rocking a pair of smart and versatile cigarette pants with that long kurti? Easy on the eyes and tasteful, cigarette pants look good with almost every type of kurti! Fancy donning a long embroidered jacket along with your palazzos? These jackets will add extra definition and detail to your ensemble. Here's a quick example for you to nail this look. Pair a long white kurti with white palazzos and add a long, printed jacket over it. Throw on a pair of Kolhapuris for that extra oomph. Complete your ensemble by wearing a pair of stunning chandelier or drop earrings. Sari, not sorry!Timelessly beautiful, saris are something that Indian women love wearing. Fabrics like cotton, khadi, silk, and linen promise comfort and look extremely graceful. Similarly, chiffon saris are light and scream elegance. Stick to the pastel palette if you're not entirely comfortable with wearing bold colours to work. Add a cute little bindi and you will be good to go! Not comfortable wearing your regular sari blouse to the office? Worry not! How about a shirt blouse instead? Our Bollywood divas have been in love with this trend for quite some time now and we think it's time that you did too! Pair a crisp full-sleeved shirt blouse with a cotton or linen sari and voila! You have yourself a drop-dead gorgeous outfit that you can comfortably flaunt at your workplace. Cute and quirky peplum blouses are all the rage in town these days. Go ahead and try one out with your sari.  Twist to the originalsKurti dresses are pretty much like the 'LBD' of ethnic fashion; you must have at least one in your wardrobe! Angarakha and shirt-style kurtis make us swoon. Also, they look great with every body type! Wear a smart shirt with a printed long skirt… Who says skirts can't be worn with a buttoned shirt? This look has been all the rage in town this festive season. Pair a flared long skirt with a crisp, well-fitted shirt and get ready to make heads turn all day. Oh! Tasselled earrings work exceptionally well with this outfit. Back to the basicsHow can we not mention the quintessential ethnic work-fashion piece? Ladies, the quaint and angelic white Chikankari kurti can be your lifesaver during the festivities. Throw on a bright coloured dupatta over it for that happy burst of colour. Bandhani and Phulkari dupattas are our personal favourite! You can try on a statement neckpiece or a pair of oxidised jhumkas to go with it. Not feeling experimental? Stick to the classic anarkali. Ladies, you can never go wrong with this one. Opt for floor length and heavily flared anarkalis. The high raised A-line cut makes them look exquisite no matter the body type. How about going one step ahead with some mesmerising chaandbali earrings? You can also wear a nice front open anarkali kurti with your favourite pair of dark jeans. So there you have it! Your very own handy guide for flaunting ethnic wears at your workplace this Diwali! Text: Sanika Tamhane  Got too much to do with almost no time? Well, don’t worry as we have a look book of your next five days right here! Pick your favourite looks and shine on this Diwali. Femina puts together a variety of looks, ensuring that women of all ages get to look their best self this very Diwali. DAY ONE: DHANTERAS Raisin Option AStyle: We recommend an asymmetric kurta. A kurta is not only comfortable to wear but looks oh-so-chic, especially if there is a design element that adds to the look. The asymmetric style gives it an edgy look. If the neckline is low, then team it up with a chunky choker and mid-sized studs in the ear. If the neckline is high, leave the neck jewellery-less and wear chunky earrings. Add some bangles and finger rings and you're set.Makeup: Rosy glow makeup would look perfect with this. Apply subtle blush strokes that make your cheeks pop by adding a touch of extra blush along cheekbones, blending out toward your temples. Nude lips with defined eyes will complete the look. Punit BalanaOption BStyle: For the same vibe, but a different look, go for a layered dhoti pant teamed with a fitted top. The dhoti pant can be of a single colour and the top with it can be in a traditional print, or vice versa. The juxtaposition of plain and print makes for an interesting visual, and balances the look. Drape a long scarf around your neck, or tie it like a turban on your head to quirk it up. Round hoops at your ears and chunky bangles will complete the look.Makeup: To compliment this look we would suggest mauve accents as a preferred makeup looks. Mauve is one of those perfect shades for transitioning from warm weather to cooler temperatures because it feels more dramatic than summery shades. DAY TWO: NARKACHATRUDASHI Option AStyle: Try a sharara with a matching short kurta and dupatta. A monotone colour scheme looks subtle yet striking with the embellishments. Accessories with chaandbaalis and multiple bangles in contrasting colour.  Makeup: Highlight the eyes and the lashes with thick eyeliner and long lashes. Add faux lashes if needed. Keep the rest of the makeup nude, with just a gloss over the lips. MishruOption BStyle: Make your regular kurta stand out with an interesting bottom! Wear a slit pant that are not only comfort-plus, but take your look to the next level. To complete this look accessorise yourself with a silver oxidised choker along with matching jhumkas.Makeup:  Brighten up your face by the prominence of a highlighter unlike contouring, which has slowly but surely been disappearing from our radar, whereas highlighting has consistently been a great route for emphasizing points of your face where the light hits. Just a touch on your Cupid's bow, cheekbones, and brow arches give your skin a naturally gorgeous finish. DAY THREE: LAXMI POOJA Abu Jani Sandeep KhoslaOption AStyle: This is a day of giving ode to the goddess of wealth, Laxmi. As gold is worshipped on this day, it is apt that you wear that colour too. Wear a monotone gold sari with an embellished border. The blouse can be in a design of your choice. Ensure you wear bold earrings. The neckpiece and bangles can be as blouse design too. A maangtika won’t look amiss. Makeup: To complement the sari, you should go with matt gold eyeshadow with brown smudged eyeliner giving a smoky gold look. Neutral brown lip shade is the only other makeup you need. Anita DongreOption BStyle: A traditional sari never goes amiss! Opt for a Banarasi silk sari with rich metallic embellishments on the borders and the pallu. The blouse design can be as per your choice. Keep the jewellery traditional too. Kundan neck piece and earrings with coloured bangles and a kundan cuff is what will look best.Makeup: To enhance the overall look, keep your makeup subtle. Just put on thin wings on the eyes and nude lips with contoured cheeks. DAY FOUR: PADVA Tarun TahilianiOption AStyle: A cream coloured mid-thigh length dress-like kurta worn over flared pallazos make for an uber-chic style that will have you looking oh-so-stylish this day. If you don’t mind to show off that pristine clear skin, have a deep V neck, but if not, opt for this in a smaller V neckline. With the deep V-neck, you can wear a bold choker in the neck and mid-sized studs in your ears. Makeup: To add just a little more glamour to this look, sport rich red lips. Use a nude or light brown coloured eye shadow and just highlight the eyes with crisp eyeliner. Arpita Mehta Option BStyle: A georgette or crepe sari with flounces on one side takes the traditional sari to a new level. Have the sari in a plain fabric or just a printed one. Have the blouse heavily embellished to add the festive touch to the look. Add a matching belt over the sari and pallu to add a glam quotient. Statement earrings and a cuff at the wrist with a statement ring on the other hand… that’s the only jewellery you need for this look.Makeup: Get your eyes to do all the talking. Using the same colour as on the outfit, have your eye liner coloured, bold and bright. Keep the rest of the makeup in complete nude. DAY FIVE: BHAIDOOJ House of MasabaOption AStyle: Give your style an edge with an off-shoulder dress that follows similar asymmetry at the hem too. Pair it with straight pants and you’re ready. Wear a multi-layered long neck piece with matching pair of earrings. A funky armlet on the side where the dress doesn’t have shoulder support and some layered bangles will look very chic.Makeup: For an edgy ensemble, you need edgy makeup too. Why not opt for multi-coloured eyeliners? Use two different colours for the line above and below the eyes. A little shimmer on the eyelids and fresh pink lips is all you need. Pooja ShroffOption BStyle: A boat-neck kurta that is asymettric at the hem is also an option you can choose. From below the waist to floor-length, the hemline is in an inverted U-shape, making for an interesting design detail. Wear it over draped pants and this look will make heads turn. Wear printed top with plain bottom or vice versa. Wear oxydised choker and cuffs at your wrist, and you’re set.Makeup: Go matte for this look. Brown matte lipstick with subtle smoky eyes and you’re ready to rock the look. - Inputs by Nondini Dhawan   Dressing up for festivities is something that we all look forward to. A kurta is not only comfortable to wear but looks oh-so-chic, especially if there is a design element that adds to the look. The asymmetric style gives it an edgy look. If the neckline is low, then team it up with a chunky choker and mid-sized studs in the ear. If the neckline is high, leave the neck jewellery-less and wear chunky earrings. Add some bangles and finger rings and you're set.Makeup: Rosy glow makeup would look perfect with this. Apply subtle blush strokes that make your cheeks pop by adding a touch of extra blush along cheekbones, blending out toward your temples. Nude lips with defined eyes will complete the look. Punit BalanaOption BStyle: For the same vibe, but a different look, go for a layered dhoti pant teamed with a fitted top. The dhoti pant can be of a single colour and the top with it can be in a traditional print, or vice versa. The juxtaposition of plain and print makes for an interesting visual, and balances the look. Drape a long scarf around your neck, or tie it like a turban on your head to quirk it up. Round hoops at your ears and chunky bangles will complete the look.Makeup: To compliment this look we would suggest mauve accents as a preferred makeup looks. Mauve is one of those perfect shades for transitioning from warm weather to cooler temperatures because it feels more dramatic than summery shades. DAY TWO: NARKACHATRUDASHI Option AStyle: Try a sharara with a matching short kurta and dupatta. A monotone colour scheme looks subtle yet striking with the embellishments. Accessories with chaandbaalis and multiple bangles in contrasting colour.  Makeup: Highlight the eyes and the lashes with thick eyeliner and long lashes. Add faux lashes if needed. Keep the rest of the makeup nude, with just a gloss over the lips. MishruOption BStyle: Make your regular kurta stand out with an interesting bottom! Wear a slit pant that are not only comfort-plus, but take your look to the next level. To complete this look accessorise yourself with a silver oxidised choker along with matching jhumkas.Makeup:  Brighten up your face by the prominence of a highlighter unlike contouring, which has slowly but surely been disappearing from our radar, whereas highlighting has consistently been a great route for emphasizing points of your face where the light hits. Just a touch on your Cupid's bow, cheekbones, and brow arches give your skin a naturally gorgeous finish. DAY THREE: LAXMI POOJA Abu Jani Sandeep KhoslaOption AStyle: This is a day of giving ode to the goddess of wealth, Laxmi. As gold is worshipped on this day, it is apt that you wear that colour too. Wear a monotone gold sari with an embellished border. The blouse can be in a design of your choice. Ensure you wear bold earrings. The neckpiece and bangles can be as blouse design too. A maangtika won’t look amiss. Makeup: To complement the sari, you should go with matt gold eyeshadow with brown smudged eyeliner giving a smoky gold look. Neutral brown lip shade is the only other makeup you need. Anita DongreOption BStyle: A traditional sari never goes amiss! Opt for a Banarasi silk sari with rich metallic embellishments on the borders and the pallu. The blouse design can be as per your choice. Keep the jewellery traditional too. Kundan neck piece and earrings with coloured bangles and a kundan cuff is what will look best.Makeup: To enhance the overall look, keep your makeup subtle. Just put on thin wings on the eyes and nude lips with contoured cheeks. DAY FOUR: PADVA Tarun TahilianiOption AStyle: A cream coloured mid-thigh length dress-like kurta worn over flared pallazos make for an uber-chic style that will have you looking oh-so-stylish this day. If you don’t mind to show off that pristine clear skin, have a deep V neck, but if not, opt for this in a smaller V neckline. With the deep V-neck, you can wear a bold choker in the neck and mid-sized studs in your ears. Makeup: To add just a little more glamour to this look, sport rich red lips. Use a nude or light brown coloured eye shadow and just highlight the eyes with crisp eyeliner. Arpita Mehta Option BStyle: A georgette or crepe sari with flounces on one side takes the traditional sari to a new level. Have the sari in a plain fabric or just a printed one. Have the blouse heavily embellished to add the festive touch to the look. Add a matching belt over the sari and pallu to add a glam quotient. Statement earrings and a cuff at the wrist with a statement ring on the other hand… that’s the only jewellery you need for this look.Makeup: Get your eyes to do all the talking. Using the same colour as on the outfit, have your eye liner coloured, bold and bright. Keep the rest of the makeup in complete nude. DAY FIVE: BHAIDOOJ House of MasabaOption AStyle: Give your style an edge with an off-shoulder dress that follows similar asymmetry at the hem too. Pair it with straight pants and you’re ready. Wear a multi-layered long neck piece with matching pair of earrings. A funky armlet on the side where the dress doesn’t have shoulder support and some layered bangles will look very chic.Makeup: For an edgy ensemble, you need edgy makeup too. Why not opt for multi-coloured eyeliners? Use two different colours for the line above and below the eyes. A little shimmer on the eyelids and fresh pink lips is all you need. Pooja ShroffOption BStyle: A boat-neck kurta that is asymettric at the hem is also an option you can choose. From below the waist to floor-length, the hemline is in an inverted U-shape, making for an interesting design detail. Wear it over draped pants and this look will make heads turn. Wear printed top with plain bottom or vice versa. Wear oxydised choker and cuffs at your wrist, and you’re set.Makeup: Go matte for this look. Brown matte lipstick with subtle smoky eyes and you’re ready to rock the look. - Inputs by Nondini Dhawan   Got too much to do with almost no time? If you’re not the kind of person who likes to go all OTT with your Diwali looks, the brocade trend is tailor-made for you. While it's traditional and looks opulent, brocade silhouettes are also light-weight and functional. It will help you dance the night away in comfort. Kareena Kapoor Khan and Tara Sutaria made the perfect case for this trend, by looking festive-ready in these brocade ensembles, without comprising on the glamour quotient. Here’s a list of celebrities who will convince you to invest in a brocade kurta, lehenga or Anarkali for all the upcoming soirees you’re planning to attend. Swara BhaskarSwara Bhaskar opted for this six-yards of beauty, and styled it with a pair of shoulder dusters, keeping it elegant and chic. Karisma KapoorThe undisputed queen of style, Karisma Kapoor paired her brocade skirt with a simple white shirt. A styling trick you can incorporate if you want a fusion look. Mrunal ThakurThe versatile actress opted for mustard, brocade sharara set, an ideal look for day-time pujas and Diwali lunches. Esha GuptaEsha Gupta chose a bright, neon kurta set and styled it with a pair of statement earrings, a look you can easily recreate for the next card party. Alia BhattAlia Bhatt perfectly balanced her fiery red kurta and palazzo set with a pair of long, gold chandelier earring and a sleek bun. A classic look, one for the books.					Diwali , the festival of light, is a perfect celebration of all things bright. For those who love the style, Diwali gives them the right excuses to put their fashionable foot forward while the friends, family and loved ones come together to celebrate. If you're wondering about the Diwali fashion trends to follow, we've all the perfect compilation to strut in style for the glittering evenings.These Diwali fashion trends will also help you navigate the gifting dilemma for your girl gang and lovely women of your lives. This Diwali, you can channelize your inner diva as you get to exude exuberance, glitz and glamor in the stylish latest fashion from our perfect festive picks. Want to know which Diwali trends to pick that suit your innate style? Scroll below:Diwali Fashion Trends: Minimum Is MaximumThis Diwali, try your hands on some exhilarating minimalistic fashion . Minimalistic outfits are all the rage this season, and this Diwali, you can make the most of it. The basic principle of minimalistic fashion is to keep it simple. You can endorse a simple sari look, clubbed with natural makeup and light jewelry to mark the occasion. This Diwali fashion trend  will help you keep light and would make your celebration free of fuss. And whoever said, less is more, are obviously right. Try and find out! Tip:  You can use the art of layering to add charm to your minimalistic approach. Play up your look by mixing different textures. Diwali Fashion Trends: PalazzosPalazzos have made a distinct place in our hearts with their easy-breezy appeal and ultra-comfortable carryings. The best part about this Diwali fashion trend is that you can pair it with a crop top, tunic, kurta, Anarkali or even with a choli, and would eventually emerge out as the fashionista . Palazzos are also a top fave outfit style favored by celebs. Tip:  With a wide-legged palazzo pant , try long kurtas to add dimension to your outfit. If you're pairing it up with a tunic or long top, glam up with accessories like belts for add some definition to your look. This Diwali, show off some printed perfection Printed Maxi dresses are everybody's top favorite outfit, no matter the occasion. Come Diwali, try and pick some printed maxi dresses that match the festive appeal and accentuate your fashion game . You can go for an ethnic range, which is available in most brands or prefers something simplistic. Take cues from your favorite celebs and up your festive style game in printed maxi dresses .Tips: Don't go overboard by mixing too many different prints. However, if you're mixing patterns, don't blend more than two types of prints in your look. Go ethnic, this Diwali, with the veritable vestsWhether you are a lover of all things simple or adore a jazzed-up look, an ethnic vest, popularly known as Koti, can be the perfect pick this Diwali season. Pair it with your Anarkali, long kurta or a simple top, your festive fashion appeal would be unmatchable in this spunky Diwali fashion trend . Team it up with right accessories, and voila!Tip: Pay extra attention to the right fit. Vest, if not of the perfect fit, can break your look. This Diwali has a sequined affairThere can never be enough of sequins love possible in this world. A little bit of glitter can add the oomph to your look, making you the dazzling diva of every party. Sequins have been in vogue for quite some time. This Diwali, try on a sequined range of outfits at the glittering festivities . From sequined saris to skirts and even kurta, there's nothing that can't handle the sequin shine with elan. What would be your pick?Tips:  You look can be made much better if you add some bold colors to compliment sequins. With sequined outfits, chunky or clunky jewellery or excess accessories should be avoided. Ethnic pants are in vogue this DiwaliGone are the days when bottom wears cam with a limited range of varieties. This Diwali put your fashionable foot forward in ethnic pants. From intricately embroidered range to brocade and zari patterns, ethnic pants are all the rage this season. Pair them up with your fave kurta or crop top, the choice is all yours.Tips: Right fit is the right tip for ethnic pants fashion . Make sure the length of your kurta doesn't kill the charm of your pants. Crop top and lehenga - the perfect trend to pick this DiwaliEndorsed by all your fave celebs, crop top and lehenga combination tops our list of traditional yet spunky Diwali wear . With the accentuated oomph of the crop top and desi touch of the lehenga , this look is a sure-shot heart winner. Go plain or glittery, or printed or embroidered, there are more than one ways to rock this Diwali fashion trend. What would you choose?Tips:  Keep heavy jewellery at bay, if trying this fashion trend. It's best if you choose a simpler neckline for your crop top if you plan to wear jewelry , especially the heavy ones. Bring in comfort and fashion in dhoti salwarsDhoti salwar is a perfect blend of comfort, style and chic statement. Pair them up with a bold tank top or traditional kurtas, their appeal is undeniable. Be the head turner in this fancy, fashionable fad , this Diwali. To add more to your look, team it up with indo-western chic makeup and accessories and you're all set to rock the Diwali party this time.Tips: Do not wear a dupatta if you opt to team up your dhoti salwar with the jacket. Best to be paired with short kurta to show off the fun style. 'Cos c o-ords are in fashionAdd a twist of fusion to your festive wear with this Diwali fashion trend. Co-ords have been making a wave in the fashion scene for some time, and it's your turn to turn up the heat, this Diwali, in these new style trends .Tips: Try light jewelry and minimum accessories with this trendy look . Pay attention to the fit of your co-ord wear to avoid making it look slumpy. Bring on the desi Diwali swag in brocade This Diwali, move over the usual desi prints and try something quintessentially traditional. Brocades have been the crown jewel of the Indian textile landscape. Go for a brocade print sari or try this Diwali fashion trend in skirts or salwar-kameez. You can add the edginess to your look by going for deep-neck blouses and floral sari . Try brocade in silk or velvet to bring out its original charm.Tips:  Don't be afraid to mix and match patterned accessories with brocade. Just keep the same color family and vary the scale, and patterns, if you'd like.  Show off shararaWhy go for mundane skirt look when you can strut in style in a sharara? Ultra-comfy and edgy, this style has been the talk of the fashion town and also a celebrity-loved trend . Try long slits, sheer or mesh, there are multiple varieties of shararas to style for Diwali. Tips:  The best way to flaunt your sharara look is by teaming it up with short Kurtis. Sari with jacket are all the rage, this DiwaliWhat can be a better way to sport a sari with a fun jacket, this Diwali! This fashion fad has been making waves for its boss-lady vibes. Last season, saris with capes were the IT thing, whereas, this year, it's uber-cool to pair a  sari with a jacket . A jacket on top of your sari can totally turn around your look. From traditionally dull, you can go on to become chic and smart in a sari with just one layer. Isn't this cool? Tips:  If you sari is heavily embellished, go for bold-hued jackets . Don't be afraid of mixing textures. Full of fashion and flare Dramatic blouse sleeves have been a head turning fashion trend . This festive season, try on flared sleeved blouses with your sari and add the much-needed spunk to your desi look . You can go for long or short variety and can also opt for deep back neck for additional appeal.Tips:  If you want your blouse to do the talking, try keeping your sari simple for the occasion. Go for heavy earrings and void neckpieces. Bangles would also not be needed with this fashion trend. Diwali Fashion Trends: FAQs 1. What to wear for Diwali Diwali is the time to celebrate with your family. It is also about celebrating our colorful traditions and vibrant culture. However, what you choose to wear should stem out from your idea of âÂÂâÂÂcomfort. If you're comfortable in salwar-kameer or sari or a pant-suit or shorts, you should totally rock it with all your confidence, and fashion and trends would follow! 2. Which dress code fits for the Diwali festival? Ideally, people generally prefer wearing traditional outfits like saris, lehengas and salwar-kameer. There are several other varieties of ethnic outfits from regional areas that can be totally your pick this Diwali. If you're celebrating the festival at home, you can go for something that gives you comfort and mobility as well as style. However, if you're spending this festive time outside the home, you can try new trends and styles like ethnic pants, dhoti salwar, among others. Our advice would be to blend comfort and fashion to have a great time. 3. Is it ok to wear a black color dress on Diwali? Several people in Indian people believe that black should not be picked up to wear on Diwali day. Independently, you can decide to wear the color that you want. But, the festive feeling is all about joy and celebration with your loved ones. It's best if you take advice from a family member to avoid hurting any sentiments on this auspicious day. Bring on the desi Diwali swag in brocade This Diwali, move over the usual desi prints and try something quintessentially traditional. Brocades have been the crown jewel of the Indian textile landscape. Go for a brocade print sari or try this Diwali fashion trend in skirts or salwar-kameez. You can add the edginess to your look by going for deep-neck blouses and floral sari . Try brocade in silk or velvet to bring out its original charm.Tips:  Don't be afraid to mix and match patterned accessories with brocade. Just keep the same color family and vary the scale, and patterns, if you'd like.  Show off shararaWhy go for mundane skirt look when you can strut in style in a sharara? Ultra-comfy and edgy, this style has been the talk of the fashion town and also a celebrity-loved trend . Try long slits, sheer or mesh, there are multiple varieties of shararas to style for Diwali. Tips:  The best way to flaunt your sharara look is by teaming it up with short Kurtis. Sari with jacket are all the rage, this DiwaliWhat can be a better way to sport a sari with a fun jacket, this Diwali! This fashion fad has been making waves for its boss-lady vibes. Last season, saris with capes were the IT thing, whereas, this year, it's uber-cool to pair a  sari with a jacket . A jacket on top of your sari can totally turn around your look. From traditionally dull, you can go on to become chic and smart in a sari with just one layer. Isn't this cool? Tips:  If you sari is heavily embellished, go for bold-hued jackets . Don't be afraid of mixing textures. Full of fashion and flare Dramatic blouse sleeves have been a head turning fashion trend . This festive season, try on flared sleeved blouses with your sari and add the much-needed spunk to your desi look . You can go for long or short variety and can also opt for deep back neck for additional appeal.Tips:  If you want your blouse to do the talking, try keeping your sari simple for the occasion. Go for heavy earrings and void neckpieces. Bangles would also not be needed with this fashion trend. Diwali Fashion Trends: FAQs 1. What to wear for Diwali Diwali is the time to celebrate with your family. It is also about celebrating our colorful traditions and vibrant culture. However, what you choose to wear should stem out from your idea of âÂÂâÂÂcomfort. If you're comfortable in salwar-kameer or sari or a pant-suit or shorts, you should totally rock it with all your confidence, and fashion and trends would follow! 2. Which dress code fits for the Diwali festival? Ideally, people generally prefer wearing traditional outfits like saris, lehengas and salwar-kameer. There are several other varieties of ethnic outfits from regional areas that can be totally your pick this Diwali. If you're celebrating the festival at home, you can go for something that gives you comfort and mobility as well as style. However, if you're spending this festive time outside the home, you can try new trends and styles like ethnic pants, dhoti salwar, among others. Our advice would be to blend comfort and fashion to have a great time. 3. Is it ok to wear a black color dress on Diwali? Several people in Indian people believe that black should not be picked up to wear on Diwali day. Independently, you can decide to wear the color that you want. But, the festive feeling is all about joy and celebration with your loved ones. It's best if you take advice from a family member to avoid hurting any sentiments on this auspicious day. Diwali , the festival of light, is a perfect celebration of all things bright. For those who love the style, Diwali gives them the right excuses to put their fashionable foot forward while the friends, family and loved ones come together to celebrate. If you're wondering about the Diwali fashion trends to follow, we've all the perfect compilation to strut in style for the glittering evenings.These Diwali fashion trends will also help you navigate the gifting dilemma for your girl gang and lovely women of your lives. This Diwali, you can channelize your inner diva as you get to exude exuberance, glitz and glamor in the stylish latest fashion from our perfect festive picks. Want to know which Diwali trends to pick that suit your innate style? Scroll below:Diwali Fashion Trends: Minimum Is MaximumThis Diwali, try your hands on some exhilarating minimalistic fashion . Minimalistic outfits are all the rage this season, and this Diwali, you can make the most of it. The basic principle of minimalistic fashion is to keep it simple. You can endorse a simple sari look, clubbed with natural makeup and light jewelry to mark the occasion. This Diwali fashion trend  will help you keep light and would make your celebration free of fuss. And whoever said, less is more, are obviously right. Try and find out! Tip:  You can use the art of layering to add charm to your minimalistic approach. Play up your look by mixing different textures. Diwali Fashion Trends: PalazzosPalazzos have made a distinct place in our hearts with their easy-breezy appeal and ultra-comfortable carryings. The best part about this Diwali fashion trend is that you can pair it with a crop top, tunic, kurta, Anarkali or even with a choli, and would eventually emerge out as the fashionista . Palazzos are also a top fave outfit style favored by celebs. Tip:  With a wide-legged palazzo pant , try long kurtas to add dimension to your outfit. If you're pairing it up with a tunic or long top, glam up with accessories like belts for add some definition to your look. This Diwali, show off some printed perfection Printed Maxi dresses are everybody's top favorite outfit, no matter the occasion. Come Diwali, try and pick some printed maxi dresses that match the festive appeal and accentuate your fashion game . You can go for an ethnic range, which is available in most brands or prefers something simplistic. Take cues from your favorite celebs and up your festive style game in printed maxi dresses .Tips: Don't go overboard by mixing too many different prints. However, if you're mixing patterns, don't blend more than two types of prints in your look. Go ethnic, this Diwali, with the veritable vestsWhether you are a lover of all things simple or adore a jazzed-up look, an ethnic vest, popularly known as Koti, can be the perfect pick this Diwali season. Pair it with your Anarkali, long kurta or a simple top, your festive fashion appeal would be unmatchable in this spunky Diwali fashion trend . Team it up with right accessories, and voila!Tip: Pay extra attention to the right fit. Vest, if not of the perfect fit, can break your look. This Diwali has a sequined affairThere can never be enough of sequins love possible in this world. A little bit of glitter can add the oomph to your look, making you the dazzling diva of every party. Sequins have been in vogue for quite some time. This Diwali, try on a sequined range of outfits at the glittering festivities . From sequined saris to skirts and even kurta, there's nothing that can't handle the sequin shine with elan. What would be your pick?Tips:  You look can be made much better if you add some bold colors to compliment sequins. With sequined outfits, chunky or clunky jewellery or excess accessories should be avoided. Ethnic pants are in vogue this DiwaliGone are the days when bottom wears cam with a limited range of varieties. This Diwali put your fashionable foot forward in ethnic pants. From intricately embroidered range to brocade and zari patterns, ethnic pants are all the rage this season. Pair them up with your fave kurta or crop top, the choice is all yours.Tips: Right fit is the right tip for ethnic pants fashion . Make sure the length of your kurta doesn't kill the charm of your pants. Crop top and lehenga - the perfect trend to pick this DiwaliEndorsed by all your fave celebs, crop top and lehenga combination tops our list of traditional yet spunky Diwali wear . With the accentuated oomph of the crop top and desi touch of the lehenga , this look is a sure-shot heart winner. Go plain or glittery, or printed or embroidered, there are more than one ways to rock this Diwali fashion trend. What would you choose?Tips:  Keep heavy jewellery at bay, if trying this fashion trend. It's best if you choose a simpler neckline for your crop top if you plan to wear jewelry , especially the heavy ones. Athleisure is slowly revolutionising as the streetwear in India. Credit the enthusiastic paparazzi culture for capturing your favourite celebrities as they step in and out of the city’s hottest workout spots. We bet, by now you know that Sara Ali Khan is a Pilate’s girl, Malika Arora swears by yoga and Alia Bhatt likes to do it all, because she can. If their rock-solid abs don’t motivate you to drop the packet of chips and hit the gym, their comfortable-chic range of tracksuits definitely will. From cropped hoodies, neon jackets, and colour-blocked bombers to racer-back sports bras, and graphic printed tank tops, there’s a plethora of options to pick from. Kareena Kapoor Khan has mastered the art of more is more, even when it comes to activewear, she likes to add a pop of colour or a shade of neon. Mira Rajput Kapoor, on the other hand, is often sighted in abstract printed, neutral coloured athleisure to the gym. Here’s our edit of all the celebrity-approved tracksuits you need to invest in.  Malaika Arora Style the animal print set with a solid coloured jacket, just like Malaika Arora did. Vaani Kapoor and Sophie ChoudryIf you’re not a fan of all thing matching, opt for a neutral coloured sports bra and legging combination and round it up with a cropped jacket like Vaani Kapoor. You can also use an element of colour from the rest of your clothing in your bomber, just like Sophie Choudry. Kriti Sanon Flaunt your toned midriff in a cropped red T-shirt and track like Kriti Sanon. Elevate your style quotient with this sage green, racer-back sports bra and yoga pants, pair it with a soda orange jacket for that additional burst of colour.  Kiara AdvaniIf understated sexy with a hint of femininity is your vibe, pick Kiara Ali Advani’s bubblegum pink tracksuit while catching your next red-eye.  Mira Rajput Kapoor Mira Rajput Kapoor’s printed tracksuit with a single coloured jacket is for those like to mix it up prints and patterns in their workout wardrobe.  Kareena Kapoor Khan Trust Kareena Kapoor Khan to make you want to revisit the neon trend, full points on getting it right by styling it on an all-black outfit.					The Chopra sisters have demonstrated an alternative way to wear the popular pantsuit. Priyanka Chopra Jonas stepped out in powder pink, satin pantsuit by label Munthe, for the inaugural NBA India Game. Credit the enthusiastic paparazzi culture for capturing your favourite celebrities as they step in and out of the city’s hottest workout spots. We bet, by now you know that Sara Ali Khan is a Pilate’s girl, Malika Arora swears by yoga and Alia Bhatt likes to do it all, because she can. If their rock-solid abs don’t motivate you to drop the packet of chips and hit the gym, their comfortable-chic range of tracksuits definitely will. From cropped hoodies, neon jackets, and colour-blocked bombers to racer-back sports bras, and graphic printed tank tops, there’s a plethora of options to pick from. Kareena Kapoor Khan has mastered the art of more is more, even when it comes to activewear, she likes to add a pop of colour or a shade of neon. Mira Rajput Kapoor, on the other hand, is often sighted in abstract printed, neutral coloured athleisure to the gym. Here’s our edit of all the celebrity-approved tracksuits you need to invest in.  Malaika Arora Style the animal print set with a solid coloured jacket, just like Malaika Arora did. Vaani Kapoor and Sophie ChoudryIf you’re not a fan of all thing matching, opt for a neutral coloured sports bra and legging combination and round it up with a cropped jacket like Vaani Kapoor. You can also use an element of colour from the rest of your clothing in your bomber, just like Sophie Choudry. Kriti Sanon Flaunt your toned midriff in a cropped red T-shirt and track like Kriti Sanon. Sonam Kapoor Ahuja, Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Anushka Sharma and Alia Bhatt will convince you to trade the heavy-weight ethnic silhouettes for these elegant printed saris this festive season. Just in time when you’re planning your wardrobe for all the upcoming Diwali parties, these leading ladies have served some serious sartorial inspiration for you. While Sonam Kapoor Ahuja and Priyanka Chopra Jonas were seen sporting the trend during their movie promotions, Anushka Sharma was draped in the printed 6 yards for an award function. Here’s our edit of all the printed saris you need to bookmark for the upcoming festivities. Priyanka Chopra Jonas opted for this black, floral-printed sari by Sabyasachi and styled it with her signature sleeveless blouse. She looked like a complete head-turner when she stepped out for the promotion of her upcoming movie. During which, she rocked another printed number by the same label, this time in an off-white and red combination with a retro, polka dotted twist. If there’s a new trend on the horizon, Sonam Kapoor Ahuja is on the forefront of it. Recently, the actor wore a foliage green, micro-floral printed sari by Masaba Gupta and elevated the look with statement silver jewellery. Kapoor-Ahuja kept it easy-chic, something you can effortlessly recreate.  Anushka Sharma swears by the less in more formula, even when it comes to traditional looks, she likes to keep it minimal. Case in point, the mint-green, floral sari by Sabyasachi that she wore for an award function. Staying true to her aesthetic, she rounded off the look with statement shoulder dusters and a messy bun.  Planning the next event on your social calendar and wondering what to wear? Take cues from Kriti Sanon. The marsala hued, printed floral sari with ruffle detail by Arpita Mehta is perfect for all the upcoming Diwali Poojas as well as the late-night card parties.  Madhuri Dixit Nene epitomises grace like no other, and there’s nobody who defines timeless beauty like her. Every time she serves a look, you sit up and take notes. If bold and bright colours aren’t your style, you can opt for this pastel pink, printed organza sari by Jade like the beautiful actress did. Though this chic phenomenon is not entirely new, its popularity among people is on a rise thanks to its flamboyant presence on social media platforms. If done right, this a la mode fashion can add that extra bit of oomph to your attire. Take a moment and reminisce about the days when we would send out anxious messages to our gang asking them about their outfits. What they were donning for the night? What if our outfits matched? The horror! These momentous precautions have a taken a back seat with changing times.  Matching outfits with your friend is no more a faux pas. Instead, it has become a raging and super fun trend that is here to stay! Twinning as a trend first emerged in South Korea’s K-pop culture. While coordinating your outfits completely is not an anomaly entirely, it can overpower the essence of your real personality and make you look, umm, a little too alike. But hey! We’ve got you covered. Have a look at these simple tips and tricks to ace the twinning game. Go ahead and make that winning statement with your fashion twin! One colour palette, multiple outfitsThis is a great way to flaunt the twin-win look without being too discernible. No worries even if you and bestie have different taste when it comes to styling your clothes. The main idea is to predominantly stay within the same colour palette and explore varied outfits. Think Gigi Hadid’s and Kendal Jenner’s iconic twin ensembles Match your fabricsHere’s an easy breezy example to help you get a better idea about this tip.  You can wear a chic eyelet white cotton dress with and your twin can throw on a white top having a similar eyelet detail. Dressing in tandem with your friend in this way leaves a lot of room for experimentation.  Top to bottom! Bottom to top!Interchanging the colours of your outfit with your BFF can be really fun. Fancy sporting a cute baby pink skirt with a pastel blue top? Your BFF, on the other hand, can rock a baby pink top with a pastel blue skirt. Think out of the boxWhat’s the first thing that comes to your mind when you think about twinning? Matching your garbs, right? While this is the most popular choice, there are some other subtle ways in which you can strut your way into the twin parade. How about getting matching phone covers? You are your fashion twin will be carrying around your phone pretty much everywhere. Bring out those accessories There are a myriad of ways in which you can elevate your twinning game without synchronizing your outfits from head to toe. Add a pair of matching oxidized tribal jhumkas to your ensemble for that subtle yet classy twinning look.  So there you have it! Your very own handy guide which will aid you in conquering this super-fun trend. Lastly, we would just want to remind you that twinning is not about replicating each other’s clothes. Don’t strive to look identical! It is one thing to twin your outfit with a person and another to look like their clone. Maintaining your identity is of crucial importance. Reflect on of your personal sense of style. Ensure that your individual personality shines through your matching outfit. A lot is shouldered by the details therein. The aim is not to look like identical twins. You want to alike but different. You can wear the same shirt but pair it up with different bottoms. Wear dresses with a similar length but different prints. Yes, twinning can be that effortless. Do you worry about your ugly arms (it's all in your head)? If yes, then puffy sleeves are perfect to hide them while simultaneously making a fashion statement. Kidding. You can wear this trend anyway since it’s one of the raging fads of 2019. From designers and celebrities to influencers and fashion enthusiasts, everyone is celebrating puffy sleeves. While some like Deepika Padukone prefer going all out, others such as Priyanka Chopra Jonas like it minimal yet loud. So, if you want to keep up with the trend, you can either style a top with the detailing with tapered trousers or make them the centre of your outfit by donning a dress with large puffy sleeves. One being, it makes you look uber-classy and sophisticated, and second, it’s fuss-free since the hems fall above the ankle. We list seven celebrities who recently donned tea-length dresses for different occasions. She had a Cinderella moment, where the ‘fairy godfather’ flicked his wand, and the black and blue gown by Tommy Hilfiger lit up in blue! This was made possible with technology; the structure inside the dress was made up of metallic plates, LED lights, batteries and wire. At the same event, musician Janelle Monáe wore an exaggerated Christian Siriano balloon-hipped dress that had a motorised blinking eye on one breast! This too was an amalgamation of fashion and technology at its chicest! Katy Perry was one of the foremost though and had worn a LED dress at the Met Gala and during her tour in 2014. It’s not just the celebs that get to wear such high-tech ensembles, even daily wear is getting its fair share of technological advancement. Wrist-worn smart watches or bands have become common in recent years. But, according to a research carried out by UK-based Juniper Research, the trend is shifting to ‘connected clothing’, which is forecasted by them to become $1 billion industry in 2020! Here are some of such cool garments that you can choose from.Jacket phone: What if you could pick up calls, control music volume, and get directions by just taping or brushing the sleeves? Levi and Google have collaborated for a jacket that does just that! Digital yogi: If you’re learning yoga, and want to refine your poses and get them right, these yoga pants are just for you! Brand Nadi X has come up with the pants that sense when your yoga pose needs refining and uses haptic feedback to create small vibrations on the body part you need to adjust.Swimming in sun: We’re always worried about just how much sunscreen to apply when on the beach, wearing swimwear. Brand Neviano has come up with stylish swimsuits that have a water-proof a UV sensor that detects if the UV rays are high and if you need more sunscreen to be applied! Research is also being done on how else to incorporate technology into fashion in order to make our life easier. At Deakin University’s Institute for Frontier Materials, they’re looking into developing fibres that can store energy. They’re hoping to make garments that can be used to charge phones and other small devices. Imagine slipping your discharged phone into your pocket, and it comes out charged! Well, with more and more of our lives getting touched by technology, is this tech-forward fashion really a surprise? Ananya Panday’s checkered co-ord ensemble is also a stylish option you’d want to include in your outfit checklist. Evening-out LookBold prints are in vogue right now and we recommend slipping into a flowy, romantic dress like Priyanka Chopra Jonas or Disha Patani for an evening out with your friends or family.HikingAlthough our girl PeeCee didn’t exactly head out to trek in this ensemble, a more casual version of this outfit will do. A pair of sturdy boots, crisp khaki shorts and a tee is perfect. You can swing the athleisure way too and slip into track pants and a cotton T-shirt with sneakers. BeachIf you’re travelling to tropical climes a swimsuit has got to be on your to-carry list! It’s fresh, cool and lets your steal the limelight in all the right ways. If you’re feeling particularly bold try a casual two-piece like Malaika or don a no-fuss mini like Manushi Chhillar. Date NightBe it to the mountains or the beaches, if you’re travelling with bae, indulging in date-night is a must. You can never go wrong with the classic LBD like Lisa Haydon. If you’re looking for something slightly more casual, try a satin slip dress with gladiator flats like Manushi. You’re sorted! This year, the choker trend underwent a fashionable transformation making their way in the traditional game. These close-fitting necklaces have the potential of giving a striking definition to any outfit. Well that’s not it, this gorgeous piece of accessory also gives a well-sculpted look to the neck. Bollywood divas are going gaga over traditional chokers… Here’s how you can team your pick to ace the next ethnic look you sport: Go solo with a chunky choker.Don it with an off-shoulder style to make the necklace stand out.Team it with a plain blouse to amp up the drama. Wear it along with a long necklace for a royal touch. Pick one with coloured beads to match with your outfit.Pair it with matching statement earrings. Go for a gold and traditional version of the casual choker, as sleek as stylish. Wondering where to go choker shopping? Southern France gets lit as stars from all over the world flood the city to attend the 72nd Cannes Film Festival. The classic red-n-goldAlessandra Ambrosio storms in a dramatic red gown, solidifying our love for thigh-high slits and knotted necklines.  Mermaid magicHina Khan’s Cannes debut is all things sparkle in a stunning silver gown by Ziad Nakad. Her look features the current rage of plunging neckline and peppy play of silver.  Flower powerElle Fanning takes a fresh spin on florals in a floaty dress, made more magical with a milkmaid braid. Pretty pastelsFrédérique Bel brings carefree pastel hues to the red carpet, and we’re in awe.  Team textureChris Lee make heads turn in Balmain suit with a strong take on texture. Hustle is our daily dose of adrenaline, life is happening on the go, and comfort isn’t about leisuring in bed but launching towards new endeavours—we’re the millennials! To cater to the needs of our fast paced lives, here’s listing five new launches of 2019 that will help keep your athleisure game going as strong as stylish. Spykar GymJnsToday, there’s little time for anything, leave changing outfits thrice a day. This is why your favourite denim pants get a sassy makeover with GymJns. Spykar’s newest launch is everything you have been wishing for, think—great fit, comfy fabric, sporty style, and crazy stretchability. GymJns offer a four-way dynamic stretch in comparison to the two-way stretch of their regular variants, which make the switch from fun to fitness and leisure an effortless affair. In addition, it comes with the ease of quick drying for a completely hassle-free experience. All this with a cool and carefree semblance apt for fitness ethusiasts! Reebok PureMove BraAs they say, a good workout begins with the right wardrobe selection. To keep you fit and fabulous, Reebok is here to help you get the best out of your exercise session with PureMove Bra. Reebok’s sports bra offers a seamless fit with breathable perforations that feels like a second skin, so that you can move freely without any distraction. What’s more, you can make a statement with its unique colour collection—cold grey and bold teal.  Santoni SneakersWhoever said one needs to give up comfort for a striking style, didn’t hear about these Italian beauties. Santoni Sneakers team excellence of its ergonomic craft with utter elegance. Santoni’s handcrafted shoes are one of its kind, which adds to a sophisticated look. It’s ideal for professionals who are looking to incorporate athleisure in their work wear wardrobe.  Reebok x Gigi Hadid Clothing CollectionAnother exciting launch from the house of Reebok brings fashion and fitness together, and how! Bold, sporty, and uber-stylish, Reebok x Gigi Hadid clothing collection is an authentic representation of the model’s love for all things athletic. Chunky sneakers, uber-stylish track jackets, retro body suits…there’s a whole range waiting for you! Featuring vivid stripes, color-blocked patterns, and 90s-inspired designs, Gigi made sure to have her love of volleyball come through in each element of the collection.  Skechers D'LitesGoing gaga over the chunky sneaker trend? Skechers D'Lites collection is your playfield; go pick a pair that suits you the best! Skechers’ all-new range of sneakers showcases a wide range of dad-shoes that reiterates the 90s love for kicks, being offered in an interesting palette of bold, vivid colours. Are you letting conventions carve your style? This season, get more creative with your outfits! Instead of steering straight to the women’s section, why not explore the crazy potential of menswear to get more out of our wardrobe. Stepping away from trends won’t just feel like a breath of fresh air but will also make you stand out stylishly within your clan. Here’s how: Baggy jacketsWe’ve said it enough time that capes are taking over the season. From casual western to ethnic and formal wear, they can be seen everywhere. Pick an easy-fitting men’s jacket to take your breezy summer look a few notches higher. Basic teesLoose clothes are the way of the season. Swap your fitted T-shirt for a men’s tee that hangs loose and helps you beat the heat in style. You’ll be surprised with the range of cool graphics that the collection offers. Tuck the tee in to give your outfit a sultry definition.  													Blazers If you are building your boss lady wardrobe, opt for a blazer to complete your formal look. Picking ‘em from the men’s section offer a host of styling hacks. These blazers come with a longer length than their feminine counterparts, which pairs well with short dresses and pencil skirts. They fall comfortably and give even the most basic of outfits a sharp semblance. Wear it unbuttoned and with rolled up sleeves to feign the fit. Button down shirtsFound your preferred print in the men’s section? Take your pick without giving it a second thought. Give your men’s shirt a dainty finish by donning it with a haute high-waist skirt, throwing it over a slim-fitted tee, or better still, go for a tucked-in look with tight pants. Cool capsIf you feel hats and scarves are taming your wild spirit, set it free with caps.  													Power dressing is ruling office corridors as pants, blazers, and tailored suits take centre stage for working women. Six well-known designers show the explorable options:Nikhil ThampiCutting edge“I strongly recommend a blazer as it offers the perfect combination of formal and semi-formal for office-going women. A high-waist pencil skirt is a versatile option, and can be teamed with a variety of tops. You can also don well-fitted trousers, palazzos, and cigarette pants with different blouses for a smart look. Lastly, you can never go wrong with a crisp white or an oversized shirt.”Shruti SanchetiReality bites “With rapid globalisation and increased urbanisation, the average Indian woman is a working one and rubs shoulders with men. Wear outfits keeping cultural ethos, weather conditions, and your body type in mind. Easy-breezy silhouettes that are practical can be worn to work. Linen, chambray, rayon, and cotton are easy to maintain, so I suggest these fabrics. You can opt for neutral colour palettes and smart details, that will give a formal yet stylish spin to your ensemble.”Genes by Lecoanet HemantFuss free“Working women have always been muses for us. To ensure that empowerment shines through, combine clean lines and functionality with impactful details. We believe, mixing of textures and contrasting hues creates a powerful wardrobe. A sleek skirt or trousers in either beige or black are wardrobe essentials. Further, use belts and wallets to bring the look together for a perfect office ensemble.”Saaksha and KinniPrint party“Swap the classic white shirt and black trousers with a printed co-ordinate set. Instead of wearing a monotone pencil skirt, opt for an organza printed bottom, and pair it with a contrasting patterned blouse. You can also replace a plain black pantsuit with a bright-hued top and chequered trousers.Wearing bright prints will not only bring creativity to your work space, but also make the monotony of getting ready fun.” 													Are you letting conventions carve your style? Only if you knew what a slight change in pattern or an addition of a bold accessory could do to your style, you would never have a dull day again. Here’s bringing you 5 creative ways to spice up your wardrobe this season: Sassy suits It’s no news that pant suits are a big rage in 2019. However, keeping in line with the formal effect, it’s being sported in basic colours and patterns. Make your executive look meet the shimmer trend, go glam with prints and patterns, or swap you pants with a long skirt. Tip: If you're going for shimmer, pick a stripe-patterned suit to strike the right balance.  Big beltsThis is an accessory that has the potential of amping any outfit almost intentionally. Give your dainty collection of slim belts a rest and go for a big, bold variant for striking definition. These belts will also give your outfit a well-fitted semblance.Tip: Stick to colours that can blend well with several outfits. For starters, think black, brown and beige.  Ruffle Formal wear is not the first thought that comes to the mind when we say ruffle. But that need not be the case. Swap that prim pencil skirt for a sassy ruffle skirt or go for haute ruffle sleeves, and give your office wardrobe a flirty twist.Tip: Opt for an office-apt, knee-length skirt and let the ruffle do the talking. You will be the new talk of town.  Plunging neckline B-town divas are going gaga over this trend, and why not! This fashionable tweak can amp an elegant look with a flirty twist. However, their red carpet appearances have made us believe that it’s limited only to the ballroom. It’s time to break out of this myth and sport a plunging neckline in a basic top for a brunch date, or a summer dress for a stroll in the beach. Go wild and pair a black statement piece with a white suit-pant, if you will!Tip: Don this neckline in a no-pattern basic colour to bring the best out of it.  Bow Why should boys have all the fun? Let’s release this fashion favourite from its gender-specific role and make it a part of our work wardrobe.Tip: Play with different delicate designs to add more personality to your outfit. Feminine is in!Go on, give it a go!																		Overdoing trends can become ubiquitous and get boring. Only if you knew what a slight change in pattern or an addition of a bold accessory could do to your style, you would never have a dull day again. Here’s bringing you 5 creative ways to spice up your wardrobe this season: Sassy suits It’s no news that pant suits are a big rage in 2019. However, keeping in line with the formal effect, it’s being sported in basic colours and patterns. Make your executive look meet the shimmer trend, go glam with prints and patterns, or swap you pants with a long skirt. Tip: If you're going for shimmer, pick a stripe-patterned suit to strike the right balance.  Big beltsThis is an accessory that has the potential of amping any outfit almost intentionally. Give your dainty collection of slim belts a rest and go for a big, bold variant for striking definition. These belts will also give your outfit a well-fitted semblance.Tip: Stick to colours that can blend well with several outfits. For starters, think black, brown and beige.  Ruffle Formal wear is not the first thought that comes to the mind when we say ruffle. But that need not be the case. Swap that prim pencil skirt for a sassy ruffle skirt or go for haute ruffle sleeves, and give your office wardrobe a flirty twist.Tip: Opt for an office-apt, knee-length skirt and let the ruffle do the talking. You will be the new talk of town.  Plunging neckline B-town divas are going gaga over this trend, and why not! This fashionable tweak can amp an elegant look with a flirty twist.
